page.overview:
Who is Emmeline Vance?

Emmeline Vance (d. June/July 1996) was a witch and a member of the first and second Order of the Phoenix. She most likely fought in several battles in both the First and Second Wizarding Wars with the Order, and was also a member of the Advance Guard.

Emmeline was murdered by Death Eaters in June or July 1996. She was considered a skilful witch and her death was a significant loss to the Order.

Emmeline served as a member of the original Order of the Phoenix, an organisation constructed by Albus Dumbledore in order to oppose Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters. She fought in the First Wizarding War and ultimately survived, living well past Voldemort's first fall.

When Lord Voldemort returned to power in 1995, Vance became a member of the reconstituted Order of the Phoenix. 250px|thumb|The Advance Guard inside [[4 Privet Drive, preparing to escort Harry Potter to safety]]
